sprints.title: S5 — Nemawashi Walkthrough + Course Corrections
features: skills/council-review/SKILL.md — manual fan-out with same andon/verification protocols as autorun; --restore-autonomy flag as the single canonical floor-reset path (§8.3, v2.1 amendment A5)
Full nemawashi walkthrough in council-autorun Step 1D (§8.2 Step 1D Stages 1–4):
Stage 1: write position paper to .council/proposed/DEC-{NNNN}.md using templates/nemawashi-position-paper.md
Stage 2: sequential agent-by-agent presentation with three handles (yes / refine / disagree)
Stage 3: alignment — revise position paper with -rev{N} suffix if disagreements; repeat Stage 2
Stage 4: ratify prompt — formal confirmation after all perspectives aligned
